description: Return the full orientation envelope for a registered BrAPI connection — server identity, capabilities, content counts, suggested finders, and notes. Re-running refreshes the cached capability scan; pass an alias to read a non-default connection.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to read the connection registered under alias `default` — i.e. a prior `brapi_connect` call that did not specify an alias. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

forceRefresh.description: Bypass the cached capability profile and refetch from the server.

name: brapi_server_info

attribution.description: Attribution metadata for built-in known-server connections. Absent for custom (env-only) connections.

citation.description: Citation requested by the upstream when data is reused in publications.

homepage.description: Public homepage of the upstream dataset.

isDemo.description: True when this server hosts demo / sample data, not production records.

license.description: License under which the upstream dataset is published (e.g. "CC-BY").

auth.description: Auth summary for the active connection.

mode.description: Auth mode of the active connection.

baseUrl.description: BrAPI v2 base URL for this connection.

notableGaps.description: Common-floor services this server does NOT expose.

items.description: Common-floor service the server does not expose.

supported.description: Sorted list of supported service names.

supportedCount.description: Total distinct services the server advertises in /calls.

items.description: Common crop name as returned by /commoncropnames.

germplasmCount.description: Total germplasm hosted, when the server exposes a cheap count.

locationCount.description: Total locations hosted, when the server exposes a cheap count.

programCount.description: Total programs hosted, when the server exposes a cheap count.

studyCount.description: Total studies hosted, when the server exposes a cheap count.

dialect.description: Active dialect adapter — translates outbound filters and declares known-dead routes for this server.

disabledSearchEndpoints.description: POST /search nouns the active dialect treats as known-dead. Tools using these routes will refuse with a recovery hint.

items.description: A POST /search/{noun} route the dialect routes around.

envVar.description: Env var that pins the dialect for this alias (e.g. BRAPI_DEFAULT_DIALECT) when detection misfires.

id.description: Active dialect id (e.g. "spec", "cassavabase"). Names a registered adapter that translates outbound filters and declares known-dead routes.

inferredMappingCount.description: Number of filter translations inferred from naming conventions but not independently verified. A non-zero count means some result narrowing on this server may not fire as expected.

notes.description: Dialect-level compatibility notes for this server family.

items.description: Verified compatibility note exposed by the active dialect.

source.description: Where the dialect id came from: env-var override, URL host match, /serverinfo serverName, organizationName, or the spec passthrough fallback.

verifiedMappingCount.description: Number of filter translations the dialect has empirically verified against a live server. Higher means more confidence in the translation table.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection has been registered under the requested alias. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this envelope was composed.

nextToolSuggestions.description: Entry-point finders (studies, germplasm, variables, locations — in that order) whose GET or POST /search route this server exposes under the active dialect. Empty when none apply.

items.description: A finder the connected server supports, with the arguments to start it.

args.description: Arguments to call the tool with. Alias only — narrow further with the tool filters.

alias.description: Connection alias to pass to the suggested tool.

reason.description: Why this tool applies to the connected server.

toolName.description: Entry-point finder tool this server can serve.

brapiVersion.description: Highest BrAPI version the server reports.

title: Brapi Server Info
